text:
Interviewed: Wife. Co-operative after resistance broken down.
State of Repair: Some damp.

Special Note: These houses are probably very old. Each seems to have been split into two, given a "modern" front + generally "done up."
They are neat + pleasant but the rooms are very tiny, one being little more than a bedroom.
They may be all right for a couple but I understand one house is occupied by husband, wife + five young children.
Income: Head + wife have "known better days". After they sold their business, Head's health broke down + they lost all they had.
